findings.title: MonoToken._writeCheckpoint(address,uint32,uint256,uint256) uses a dangerous strict equality
findings.description:
A strict equality on a balance or amount can be broken by someone sending a little extra, locking the logic. Slither: MonoToken._writeCheckpoint(address,uint32,uint256,uint256) (contracts/MonoToken.sol#258-276) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- nCheckpoints > 0 && checkpoints[delegatee][nCheckpoints - 1].fromBlock == blockNumber (contracts/MonoToken.sol#268)

findings.title: MonoToken.delegateBySig(address,uint256,uint256,uint8,bytes32,bytes32) uses timestamp for comparisons
findings.description:
Logic depends on block.timestamp, which miners can nudge by a few seconds (informational). Slither: MonoToken.delegateBySig(address,uint256,uint256,uint8,bytes32,bytes32) (contracts/MonoToken.sol#124-165) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- require(bool,string)(block.timestamp <= expiry,MONO::delegateBySig: signature expired) (contracts/MonoToken.sol#163)
